title.en: 旧开发试玩包清理记录
title.zh: 旧开发试玩包清理记录

rules.zh: 匍匐WASD／斜向60厘米/秒，鼠标身体转向须满足逐角度净空和三点支撑；教学无隐藏起终点门槛。
rules.en: Prone WASD/diagonals60cm/s; mouse body yaw requires sampled clearance/three supports; lesson has no hidden start/end gate.

rules.zh: 守军明确继续后才激活；盟军基础教学结束后显示招募。
rules.en: Guards activate only on explicit Continue; Allies appear for recruitment after basics.

rules.zh: 备用弹、手雷与烟雾各有限库存、容量与发放账目。
rules.en: Reserve rounds, frags and smoke have finite stock, capacity and receipts.

rules.zh: CP0为用户要求的训练存档；CP1只看三守军全灭，不加小队到齐门槛。
rules.en: CP0 is the user-requested training save; CP1 requires only three guards dead, without a squad-arrival gate.

rules.zh: 走路目标距出生约14米，跑步下一段约18米且至少实际跑12米；绿色路线仅两课。
rules.en: Walk target14m from start; Run next leg18m with12m real sprint; route lines only in these lessons.

rules.zh: CP0保存／读档后可向桥方向离圈自然开战，未保存不能自动跳过。
rules.en: Saved/restored CP0 starts combat on forward departure; unsaved skip never automatic.

rules.zh: 界面与教学默认简体中文；Esc→设置→语言（本页L）切换英文并单独记住，不写入任务存档。
rules.en: UI/lessons default to Simplified Chinese; Esc→Settings→Language (or L there) persists language separately from mission saves.

steps.zh: 鼠标观察；Esc暂停并放出鼠标。
WASD走、Shift跑、Space跳、Ctrl蹲；Z趴稳，鼠标转向，四方向各实际15厘米／总2.5米自动进入Z起身。
steps.en: WASD walk, Shift run, Space jump, Ctrl crouch; stable Z prone/mouse turn,15cm each direction/2.5m total automatically enters Z stand.

steps.zh: 真实开2枪、R装弹；滚轮选择并长按／释放左键投手雷与烟雾。
steps.en: Fire two actual shots/reload; wheel and held/released primary throw frag/smoke.

steps.zh: 三类有限补给，然后原长按E2秒拆教学雷。
steps.en: Finite three-resource resupply, then original two-second E-hold teaching-mine disarm.

steps.zh: 固定点分别E对话、另次输入确认Join。
steps.en: E dialogue at fixed sites, separate explicit Join input.

steps.zh: CP0圈内E确认保存，明确Continue开始桥头实战。
steps.en: E confirmation in CP0; explicit Continue opens combat.

steps.zh: 三守军全灭后CP1保存成功结束教程。
steps.en: After three guard deaths, durable CP1 saving completes teaching.

open_items.zh: 人工复核手雷称呼和教学保存前后提示。
open_items.en: Human review grenade terminology and teaching save-state prompts.

open_items.zh: 后续市区M2/M3与备用招募人员尚未实现。
open_items.en: Later-city M2/M3 and reserve recruits are not implemented.

note.en: Human-adopted tutorial1.0; unchanged reviewed Game.
note.zh: 教学正式版1.0，原样采用已验收Game。

新出生准入锚点，后移约23.5米。

rules.zh: 补给点独立有限库存；普通弹药箱不自动提供药品。德军掉落按任务种子和固定身份预先决定，不因重试重抽。
rules.en: Supply sites have independent finite stocks; ammunition boxes do not automatically provide medicine. German loot is predetermined by mission seed and stable identity, without retry rerolls.

rules.zh: 存档回滚生命、持有量、补给库存、固定掉落和领取状态。旧存档不凭空获得药品或生命。
rules.en: Checkpoints restore health, inventory, finite stocks, fixed loot and claims together. Legacy saves receive no invented medicine or health.

rules.zh: 教程指定1号德军固定1包，另两名各25%；后续Supply2独立1包，第一段不发药。
rules.en: German1 has one guaranteed teaching kit; German2/3 each25%; later Supply2 has one separate kit; none in the first stage.

rules.zh: 移除第一段备用箱的模型和交互，新开局合并有限库存；旧档库存身份与收支保留。
rules.en: Remove the duplicate training box representation/interaction and consolidate new-session stock; preserve old save identities and receipts.

open_items.zh: 单一弹药箱与完整教程仍待明确人工复核；无完整精细接触、全地图、压力、Editor/PIE或第二台机器验收。
open_items.en: Single-ammunition-box and complete tutorial human review remain unconfirmed; exhaustive contact, full-map, stress, Editor/PIE and second-machine acceptance remain open.

note.zh: 本次明确要求的独立教学试玩已构建，保留最新握姿/V/Ctrl/教程界面和原档；不是正式采用。
note.en: Requested independent combined tutorial trial built with current grips/V/Ctrl/UI and original saves preserved; not formal adoption.

note.zh: 2026年10月17日用户明确通过医疗包建模、回血动作、掉落拾取；对应Game_v17。此前5组同Game检查与无诊断启动证据保留。
note.en: On17 October2026 the human explicitly accepted medical pouch modeling, healing action and drop/pickup on Game_v17. Prior five matching-Game cases and diagnostics-disabled startup evidence retained.
